statements.impact_statement: The image's firefox is Mozilla's own deb (packages.mozilla.org; Firefox 158 in coder-workspace 1.9.4), not Ubuntu's firefox package: Ubuntu's fixed version 1:1snap1-0ubuntu1 is its transitional package that installs the snap, not a code fix. Firefox 158 bundles libexpat 2.8.4 (parser/expat/moz.yaml at FIREFOX_158_0_RELEASE), which carries this fix (libexpat 2.4.3); every Firefox since 138 vendors upstream libexpat 2.6.4 or later (bug 1950575). Fixed in Firefox 98 and ESR 91.7: Mozilla cherry-picked the fixes into its expat (bug 1754724).

The flaw is in the Rust crate crossbeam-utils before 0.8.7. Firefox 158 vendors only crossbeam-utils 0.8.21 (Cargo.lock at FIREFOX_158_0_RELEASE); fixed in Firefox 113, since when every copy is 0.8.7 or later. It also only affects targets where u64 is less aligned than AtomicU64 (32-bit ones), not x86-64.

Mozilla assessed its earlier expat not affected (bug 1754724, Firefox 98: XML_CONTEXT_BYTES is zero; no element declaration handler is set); fixed in Firefox 138 with the upstream libexpat.
